name: Brauronia
summary: Artemis' festival at Brauron, where selected Athenian girls 'played the bear' before marriage — the arkteia — and where Iphigenia, the Athenians said, left the Tauric image of the goddess.
testimonia: Pausanias 1.33.1 (Iphigenia lands the image at Brauron)
Pausanias 1.23.7 (Brauronian Artemis on the Acropolis; the old wooden image at Brauron)
Aristophanes, Lysistrata 641–647 (the arktos among a girl's ritual stages)
Parke (1977) 139–140 (the Brauronia; exact day within Mounichion unfixed — Attic mapping approximate)
